thread:
Laura: Heads up — AeroMedical flagged a ~$9.8k overage on invoice INV-2026-03-17. They say it was from test VMs in staging that accidentally hit prod endpoints. Can we review for a goodwill credit?
Anish: Do we have a support ticket number? cc Tess for billing ops.
Tess: On it. Can you paste invoice #, account id, and timeframe so I can pull usage logs?
Laura: INV-2026-03-17, period 2026-03-01 to 2026-03-15. Account: aero-med-prod (acct_7890). Ticket: https://support.redwood/a/12345
Tess: Thanks — initial scan shows a token burst on 2026-03-09 03:14 UTC, ~1.2M tokens coming from a single API key. Looks like non-human traffic pattern.
Sam: Is this the same customer who mixed staging keys with prod last month? If so, our usual flow is partial goodwill + guidance. Anything > $5k needs finance approval.
Tess: Our ops playbook: accidental test traffic -> manual credit up to 100% (first incident) but >$5k requires finance sign-off. I'll prepare a draft credit memo.
Maria: I can review. Please share the draft credit memo, invoice, and a confirmation from the customer that they've rotated the key. If they're on an annual contract we'll also need AR loop-in.
Laura: Quick paste of the log snippet (redacting full keys):
```
2026-03-09T03:14:02Z  acct_7890  api_key=sk-test-xyz123  model=gpt-4-mini  tokens=1203456  endpoint=/v1/complete
2026-03-09T03:14:05Z  acct_7890  api_key=sk-test-xyz123  tokens=98321  endpoint=/v1/complete
```
Tess: Draft credit memo created: CM-2026-0042, amount $9,800 (100% of overage). Reason: accidental test traffic to production endpoints. Pending rotation confirmation from customer. Approve?
Maria: :thumbsup: I approve a provisional $9,800 credit pending customer confirmation that keys were rotated and mitigation steps taken. Require signed acknowledgement in the ticket before posting.
Anish: I'll reach out in the ticket and request the rotation confirmation + signed mitigation ack. Pinged AeroMedical ops in the support thread.
Laura: Once confirmed, Tess — please post the credit against INV-2026-03-17, update AR, and add the audit note. Also recommend they enable API key restrictions and rotate.
Tess: Will do. I'll attach a short remediation checklist to the ticket and recommend IP restrictions + key rotation. I'll hold on posting the credit until the signed ack is in the ticket.
Maria: Please CC finance-approvals@redwood.com when you post the credit, and tag the invoice for audit.
Sam: Recording for ledger: provisional approval by Maria on 2026-03-20 14:10 UTC. If/when posted, I'll mark CM-2026-0042 in the revenue system and reconcile in next close.
Laura: Thanks team — keeping customer happy but protecting against repeat. If they refuse mitigation, we'll revisit partial credit.
Tess: Noted. I'll update this thread when the ticket has confirmation. :white_check_mark:
